_fixture_note: Represents a failure fetching page 2 of 3, after page 1 (03_pagination_page_1_of_3.json) already succeeded and returned a nextToken. Use alongside 03_pagination_page_1_of_3.json to exercise partial-run/resume-vs-restart handling. Per product decision, the first version is not resumable: a mid-pagination failure must restart from page 1 on the next attempt, and the run for this attempt must be recorded as failed/partial with truthful received/accepted counts reflecting only page 1's items.
